'''Elmira Teymur qızı Süleymanova''' ({{langx|az|Elmira Teymur qızı Süleymanova}}; 17 July 1937 – 25 April 2024) was an Azerbaijani chemist and civil servant. In 2002, she became the Commissioner for Human Rights (Ombudsman) of the Republic.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bakı Dövlət Universtiteti |title=CD Dedicated to the Fifth Anniversary of the Commissioner for Human Rights (Ombudsman) of the Republic of Azerbaijan |url=http://anl.az/el/a/arotihi.pdf |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220308202426/http://anl.az/el/a/arotihi.pdf |archive-date=8 March 2022 |access-date=28 April 2024 |website=Milli Kitabxana}}</ref>

== Biography==
Süleymanova was born in [[Baku]] on 17 July 1937 and graduated in [[chemistry]] from the [[Baku State University|State University of Azerbaijan]] and graduated with honors. She then worked in the Institute of Petrochemical Processes of [[Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences]] as a laboratory assistant and later became the head of the laboratory. She got a postgraduate degree from the [[Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences|National Academy of Sciences]] in 1967 and a doctorate in 1980. She started working as a university professor in 1988. She was also a member of the [[New York Academy of Sciences]] from 1997 onward. She was the author of 200 scientific works and collaborated in around 40 inventions for the chemistry and perfumery industries.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Elmira Suleymanova (Azerbaijan) {{!}} WikiPeaceWomen – English|url=http://wikipeacewomen.org/wpworg/en/?page_id=1243|access-date=7 May 2021|website=wikipeacewomen.org|archive-date=6 January 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190106043224/http://wikipeacewomen.org/wpworg/en/?page_id=1243|url-status=live}}</ref>

Süleymanova was an expert in [[petrochemical]]s and [[organic chemistry]]. She was the founder and honorary president of the Azerbaijan Women and Development Center, a non-profit organization that has a consultative status with the [[United Nations Economic and Social Council|UN Economic and Social Council]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Azerbaijan "Women and Development" Center (AWDC) |url=http://www.azerweb.az/en/ngo.php?id=262 |access-date=7 May 2021 |website=Azer Web |archive-date=5 January 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190105201743/http://www.azerweb.az/en/ngo.php?id=262 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Süleymanova died in Baku on 25 April 2024, at the age of 86.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-04-25 |title=Elmira Süleymanova vəfat etdi |url=https://qafqazinfo.az/news/detail/elmira-suleymanova-vefat-etdi-434012 |access-date=2024-04-25 |website=Qafqazinfo |language=az |archive-date=25 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240425225520/https://qafqazinfo.az/news/detail/elmira-suleymanova-vefat-etdi-434012 |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Career as Ombudsman ==
The [[National Assembly (Azerbaijan)|National Assembly]] elected Süleymanova as the first [[Ombudsman]] on 2 July 2002,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://ombudsman.gov.az/en/view/pages/65|title=Decisions of the Milli Majlis on election of the Commissioner|website=www.ombudsman.gov.az|language=en|access-date=23 March 2018|archive-date=1 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200801165420/http://ombudsman.gov.az/en/view/pages/65|url-status=dead}}</ref> and re-elected her in 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Commissioner For Human Rights Re-Elected |url=https://www.theioi.org/ioi-news/current-news/commissioner-for-human-rights-re-elected |access-date=2024-04-25 |website=International Ombudsman Institute (IOI) |language= |archive-date=23 July 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180723142730/http://www.theioi.org/ioi-news/current-news/commissioner-for-human-rights-re-elected |url-status=live }}</ref>

In 2004, regarding the 30-year prison sentence of [[Ramil Safarov]], she stated that Safarov's punishment was too harsh and that "Safarov must become an example of [[patriotism]] for the Azerbaijani youth".<ref>{{cite web |url=http://iwpr.net/report-news/murder-case-judgement-reverberates-around-caucasus |title=Murder Case Judgement Reverberates Around Caucasus |last1=Grigorian |first1=Marina |last2=Orujev |first2=Rauf |date=20 April 2006 |work=[[Institute for War and Peace Reporting|Institute for War & Peace Reporting]] |accessdate=12 September 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120905071818/http://iwpr.net/report-news/murder-case-judgement-reverberates-around-caucasus |archivedate=5 September 2012 }}</ref><ref>“Zerkalo” Newspaper, Baku, 28 February 2004</ref>

In 2015, she was named vice president of the Asian Ombudsman Association,<ref>{{Cite web |date=21 June 2020 |title=Elmira Suleymanova elected vice-president of Asian Ombudsman Association |url=https://report.az/en/foreign-politics/elmira-suleymanova-elected-vice-president-of-asian-ombudsman-association/ |access-date=25 April 2024 |website=Report News Agency |language=en |archive-date=5 January 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190105201410/https://report.az/en/foreign-politics/elmira-suleymanova-elected-vice-president-of-asian-ombudsman-association/ |url-status=live }}</ref> and was also a member of the European Ombudsman Institute. As Ombudsman, she implemented programs that aimed to protect the status of women, the elderly, displaced youth, the poor, and victims of violence.

[[President of Azerbaijan|President]] [[Ilham Aliyev]] awarded her the [[Shohrat Order|Order of Glory]] in 2007 and the [[Sharaf Order|Order of Honor]] in 2017 for her contribution to the defense of human rights.<ref>[http://www.e-qanun.az/framework/13651 E. T. Süleymanovanın "Şöhrət" ordeni ilə təltif edilməsi haqqında] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190105201344/http://www.e-qanun.az/framework/13651 |date=5 January 2019 }} {{in lang|az}}</ref><ref>[http://president.az/articles/24678 E.T.Süleymanovanın “Şərəf” ordeni ilə təltif edilməsi haqqında Azərbaycan Respublikası Prezidentinin Sərəncamı] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180324091423/http://president.az/articles/24678 |date=24 March 2018 }} {{in lang|az}}</ref><ref>[http://www.1news.az/az/news/elmira-s-leymanova-r-f-ordeni-il-t-ltif-edilib Elmira Süleymanova “Şərəf” ordeni ilə təltif edilib] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190105201734/http://www.1news.az/az/news/elmira-s-leymanova-r-f-ordeni-il-t-ltif-edilib |date=5 January 2019 }} {{in lang|az}}</ref>

==Controversy==
In 2004, she stated that axe murderer [[Ramil Safarov]] should serve as "an example for Azerbaijani youth".<ref>United Nations General Assembly, ''A/59/576–S/2004/913'', 19 November 2004.</ref>
